description: Transportation of media containing CUI is not protected through approved custodians, secure packaging, or tracking mechanisms. This signal indicates media may be lost, stolen, or compromised during transport.
applicability: Applicable to all media transport scenarios. Includes courier services, internal transport, shipping of backup media, and any movement of CUI-containing media between locations.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through media transport procedure review, chain of custody verification, and transport tracking assessment.
